info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Management Manual Update API
info.description: The Management Manual Update API enables users to efficiently modify existing management manuals associated with knowledge assets in the banking sector. This endpoint supports business operations such as editing critical information, enhancing documentation, and ensuring compliance with updated regulations. Typical consumers include compliance officers, banking administrators, and operational teams who rely on accurate knowledge resources. By leveraging this API, organizations can maintain up-to-date manuals that reflect current practices and guidelines within their operations.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the specific management manual identified by its resource ID (RES-100045). Ensure the request includes the necessary parameters for the update to be processed successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the operation for the specified management manual asset. It expects a JSON object that defines the changes to be made.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
